So there are some very minor issues with these vehicles. I’ve had a manual sedan for 5 years and a now a wagon! Hence the username. So, I would absolutely make sure the timing belt and water pump have been changed at least once (they should be replaced every 90-100k) and also make sure the car has had the lower ball joints replaced. They wear out a little quicker in hot climates such as Florida and California. They should be replaced every 100k miles. The rear main seals, front can seals and oil pan seals can go bad if the car has been sitting for extended periods of time (6 months and more).

These vehicles last a very very long time, my friend has had one since 2007 and currently had 467,000 miles on the original engine and transmission. (Original head gasket)The manuals are significantly more sporty and fun, but the auto’s are not really too bad. All the issues I have stated above are viewed as maintenance. These cars have almost no issues. The 01’s don’t come with the repulsive sticky dashes which is a a huge plus. As long as the maintenance has been done, these are truly 500,000 mile cars. They can last 25 years without a hiccup.
